verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a telemetry timeline of "breadcrumbs" events in rollbar.js, plus telemetry capture from Apple Unified Logging. Its person tracking attaches affected users to errors, automatically in Rails and Django. Nothing in the evidence shows custom tags or arbitrary key-value context attached to events. Missing for 10: documented custom tags/metadata on events, evidence that breadcrumbs work across SDKs beyond JS and Apple, detail on setting user context manually, independent hands-on corroboration.
